scope: Additive public-source audit for permanent Home Village Hero battlefield artwork. It imports no replacement art and changes no combat, geometry or rendering contract.
game_version: Public asset repository commit d84d7fa19e546047b6d1acf6f00c14519da8c00f, consulted 2026-09-21. The frozen 2026-09-17 reference remains unchanged.

sources.title: ClashKing Assets
facts: The repository contains one icon asset for each of Barbarian King, Archer Queen, Grand Warden, Royal Champion, Minion Prince and Dragon Duke.
Its pinned Hero directories contain no world sprite, anchor metadata, animation frame or attack visual asset for those Heroes.
sources.limitations: This is a community asset extractor. It identifies a second public icon source only and cannot establish exact in-battle art fidelity.

audit.result: No battlefield sprite or animation source was available in the pinned public inventory.

conclusion: The second public asset audit corroborates the existing icon-only status. No generated or generic replacement is introduced and exact battlefield assets remain explicitly unavailable.
